title.zh: 长曲子渲染快 2.5 倍、单音符力度可看可改、导出会报进度与剩余时间
title.en: Long renders 2.5× faster, a note's velocity you can see and change, and an export that says how much longer

highlights.zh: 五分钟的编曲渲染从 753 秒降到 297 秒：长曲子默认分成多段、多个进程并行；等价性由逐样本判据守住（交叉淡化窗口外 ≤ −60 dBFS），带采样轨的形状自动回退单次渲染并说明原因。`chunks: 1` 可显式关掉。
highlights.en: A five-minute arrangement went from 753 s to 297 s: a long piece is rendered as several spans across processes by default, with the equivalence held by a sample-accurate criterion (≤ −60 dBFS outside the crossfades), and a pattern carrying a sample lane falls back to one pass and says why. `chunks: 1` turns it off.

highlights.zh: 单个音符的力度现在看得到也改得了：音符带着自己的力度，框选后用工具条的滑杆统一调整，每个音符一步撤销。
highlights.en: A note's velocity is visible and editable: notes carry their own value, and a selection can be re-voiced from the toolbar slider, with one undo step per note.

highlights.zh: 导出的母带报进度与剩余时间——数字来自渲染器自己的每 10% 回调，不再只有一个「导出中…」。
highlights.en: A master export reports progress and time left, taken from the renderer's own ten-percent callbacks instead of a single "Exporting…".
